answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 8414 Country: United States of America Title: As Salaam Mu Alaykum Wa Rahmatullah, Is it okay for a 'Syed' (decendent of the Prophet SAW) Muslim Girl to marry an non-Syed (I heard it's better to marry a Syed) or is it better to marry a Syed? What's the complete Masla? Also, what is the ruling on a wife calling her husband by his name? Is it permissible or is it a sin or is it just better not to do so? JazakAllah Was Salaam Question: As Salaam Mu Alaykum Wa Rahmatullah, Is it okay for a 'Syed' (decendent of the Prophet SAW) Muslim Girl to marry an non-Syed (I heard it's better to marry a Syed) or is it better to marry a Syed? What's the complete Masla? Also, what is the ruling on a wife calling her husband by his name? Is it permissible or is it a sin or is it just better not to do so? JazakAllah Was Salaam Answer ID: 8414 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2035/1663=H/1429) If the guardian marries a syed girl with a non-syed boy then it is lawful and valid. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
